basic_info.description: Discover urban-chic living in this stylish and expansive 1 bd/1.5 ba loft, situated in a boutique building located in San Francisco's vibrant Mission District. With soaring ceilings and floor to ceiling windows, the space is bathed in natural light, creating a sun-drenched, welcoming ambiance.  An inviting open floor plan features a modern kitchen with ample room for preparing fabulous meals and providing a seamless entertaining experience that is sure to dazzle. Completing the main level is your private deck, a powder room, and an in-unit washer/dryer. The primary suite on the loft level offers a peaceful retreat with an ensuite bathroom and a large walk-in closet. The residence also includes garage parking, storage space and a shared rooftop with city views. Situated just a short walk from the district's renowned eateries, Gus's Market, Tartine Manufactory, and other hot spots, this location is perfect for the busy urbanite, with easy 101/280, Caltrain, and MUNI lines ensuring effortless commuting!
